facts.value: decideFighter reads Fighter.kind and dispatches through a 17-entry switch table covering kinds 8 through 24, using the default path outside that range. Ness, Peach and GameWatch receive only the fighter object after facing has been assigned; they do not receive the supplied stick angle. Pikachu/Pichu use common doEnter with stick_angle and then install effect hitlag callbacks; remaining kinds use common doEnter with stick_angle.
facts.rationale: The old final sentence attributed angle consumption to every selected branch, but only common doEnter receives the angle.

evidence.why: The old final sentence attributed angle consumption to every selected branch, but only common doEnter receives the angle.

facts.value: The split section is 16 bytes: f32 zero, one and minus one at offsets 0, 4 and 8 plus four zero bytes. The existing source object contains the three literal words in 12 bytes. Source flags are WRITE|ALLOC and split flags ALLOC; final runtime protection is not established. This is compiler literal storage, not a gameplay aggregate.
facts.rationale: Existing objects distinguish source/split size and flags; the read-only assertion is not true of the source ELF.

facts.value: When allow_interrupt is set, initial priority is side special, up special via ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput, neutral special via ftCo_800D6824, down special via ftCo_800D68C0, then grab. If no earlier return occurs, ftCo_800CECE8 checks the command-gated A-button forward-smash follow-up independently of allow_interrupt. If interruption is allowed and no earlier check succeeds, the remaining order is forward/up/down smash; forward/up/down tilt; neutral attack; ftCo_80091A4C; ftCo_800DE9D8; jump; dash; ftCo_800D5FB0; turn; walk. Each true result ends processing.
facts.rationale: The Attack100-named helpers call the SpecialHi/SpecialN/SpecialLw tables, not rapid-jab logic. The independently gated follow-up is reached only without an earlier return.

facts.value: Tests angle bins in priority order: above xB8_radians with a nonzero AttackS4S motion-data x8 selects AttackS4Hi; otherwise above xBC_radians with a nonzero AttackS4LwS x8 selects AttackS4HiS; otherwise below xC4_radians with a nonzero AttackLw4 x8 selects AttackS4Lw; otherwise below xC0_radians with a nonzero AttackHi4 x8 selects AttackS4LwS; all remaining cases select AttackS4S. It then disables interruption, clears command variable 0 and all throw flags, enters the chosen motion at frame 0 with rate 1 and no motion flags, and initializes animation state.
